name: Tempester n°8: loop counter advance aligned on the window (Loop Screen freeze outside 4/4)
explanation: The sequencer advances its positions by af8 + (x + d) % afc (af8 = [address] window start, afc = [address] length). This is a true step of d inside the window only if af8 % afc == 0 (the 4/4 case); otherwise the offset advances by af8 % afc + d and the catch-up loop of the ISR (while target != [address], [address]-[address]) may never reach its target: freeze (Loop Screen in an odd time signature, beat changes in sync). The three advance sites (ISR [address], [routine], [routine] branch d < x) call a common subroutine at 0x9d07b300 that computes af8 + ((x + d) + afc - af8 % afc) % afc = af8 + (x - af8 + d) mod afc, without unsigned underflow. Identical to the former computation for every x as soon as af8 % afc == 0; division by zero still guarded (teq, code 7).

edits.why: [routine] (sequencer ISR): call of the advance subroutine instead of divu ([address]+1)%afc (jal 0x9d07b300)
branch delay slot: a0 = [address] + 1 (s4); the original teq guard is taken over in the subroutine (or a0,s4,zero)
s1 = new offset in the window (v0 - af8), in place of mfhi (subu s1,v0,s2)
s3 = af8 + ([address] - af8 + 1) mod afc (v0), in place of af8 + ([address]+1)%afc (or s3,v0,zero)
[routine] branch d < x (step back by d ticks): tail jump to the subroutine instead of lw afc (j 0x9d07b300)
branch delay slot: a0 = x - d (a2, no underflow since d < x) (or a0,a2,zero)
[routine] (generic advance by d ticks): tail jump to the subroutine instead of divu (x+d)%afc (j 0x9d07b300)
branch delay slot: a0 = x + d (a2); the subroutine's jr ra returns to the caller (or a0,a2,zero)
common advance subroutine: lui t9,0xa001
common advance subroutine: lw t8,-0x6504(t9) : afc
common advance subroutine: lw t9,-0x6508(t9) : af8
common advance subroutine: divu t9,t8 | common advance subroutine: teq t8,zero,7 (division by zero guarded)
common advance subroutine: mfhi v0 : af8 % afc
common advance subroutine: subu v0,t8,v0 : afc - af8 % afc
common advance subroutine: addu v0,v0,a0 : + (x + d)
common advance subroutine: divu v0,t8
common advance subroutine: teq t8,zero,7 (division by zero guarded)
common advance subroutine: mfhi v0 : (x + d - af8) mod afc
